# Aman Goel

> Senior Applied Scientist, AWS Automated Reasoning Group. Neurosymbolic AI, agentic AI,
> LLM post-training, and AI safety: making LLMs safer and more reliable (formal verification
> of outputs, hallucination detection, red teaming), after a PhD on automatic verification of
> hardware and distributed protocols — the first fully automatic proof of Lamport's Paxos (to
> our knowledge) and a hardware model checker that won HWMCC 2020. Views his own.

The main pages have Markdown twins; agents should prefer the .md URLs below.

- [Home (Markdown)](https://amangoel.ai/index.md): bio, news & highlights, selected work — who I am and the thesis of the work
